title: tftp-enum
author: Alexander Rudakov
description: Enumerates TFTP (trivial file transfer protocol) filenames by testing for a list of common ones. TFTP doesn't provide directory listings. This script tries to retrieve filenames from a list. The list is composed of static names from the file tftplist.txt, plus configuration filenames for Cisco devices that change based on the target address, of the form A.B.C.X-confg for an IP address A.B.C.D and for X in 0 to 255. Use the tftp-enum.filelist script argument to search for other static filenames. This script is a reimplementation of tftptheft from http://code.google.com/p/tftptheft/.
